embeds.description:
CISA added CVE-2026-45247, a critical deserialization vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer (a Magento extension), to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog following reports of active exploitation. Sansec identified approximately 6,000 stores running Mirasvit extensions, and Imperva reported observing active attack activity targeting gaming and business sites primarily in the U.S., U.K., France, and Australia. The threat actor identity remains unknown, though exploitation appears aimed at identifying vulnerable Magento environments and confirming remote code execution capability.

embeds.title: 🟡 Microsoft Blames Unexpected Windows Driver Updates on Caching Issue
embeds.description:
Microsoft confirmed that a misconfiguration in the Windows Update caching service caused some Windows devices to install driver updates without notice despite policies configured to prevent auto-updates. The issue temporarily dropped device enrollment information, causing affected devices to be treated as non-enrolled and preventing driver-approval controls from being applied. Microsoft confirmed the drivers installed were Microsoft-approved and posed no security threat. The company mitigated the issue by updating the affected service cache and enrollment status. Windows admins reported tens of thousands of devices unexpectedly receiving BIOS and driver updates, in some cases causing audio or video devices to stop functioning.
